title: Thai Garlic Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Thai dish made with garlic, rich flavors, and a stir fry technique.

ingredients.name: Stir fry vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the stir fry vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Season with fish sauce to taste.
Serve the vegetables over cooked rice.
